Who is Alex Caffi?

Alessandro "Alex" Caffi (born March 18 1964 in Rovato, Italy) is a retired driver. He made his debut at the 1986 Italian Grand Prix in an , and entered 77 Grands Prix, where he participated in 75 weekends, and started 56 races.
